releases.notes: Full re-pull per locked decision. Schema v2: 82 columns. Total emissions column renamed by ECCC to '... - excl. CO2bio'. Verified comparable to the old total on 2023 overlap: 1731 of 1854 matched facilities exact, median relative diff 0.0, 50 facilities revised over 1 percent (ECCC revisions). Definition note: the v2 total explicitly excludes biogenic CO2 (CO2bio); the v1 total carried no such qualifier. Overlap verified comparable, but analysts comparing pre/post-refresh totals for biomass reporters should account for this.
